task: Predict disease-specific survival in non-small cell lung cancer using discretized time bins. Each class represents one of four time bins from early to late, with censored versus disease-specific death status. H&E indicators of worse disease-specific outcome include poor differentiation, necrosis, lymphovascular invasion, pleural invasion, and high stromal desmoplasia or tumor budding.

classes.0: Earliest time bin, censored — short disease-specific follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.1: Second time bin, censored — intermediate-early follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.2: Third time bin, censored — intermediate-late follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.3: Fourth time bin, censored — longest follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.4: Earliest time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred early, consistent with aggressive tumor morphology.
classes.5: Second time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-early timepoint.
classes.6: Third time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-late timepoint.
classes.7: Fourth time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred late after prolonged disease-specific survival.
